outcome: accuracy in identifying the L4-L5 lumbar interspace
number of clinical assessments above the third lumbar vertebra
cohort: 110 singleton pregnant women with gestational age greater than 37 weeks
finding: The SAIL technique was found to be significantly more accurate than the ICL technique for identifying the L4-L5 interspace in pregnant women, and it also resulted in fewer estimations above the third lumbar vertebra.
